# AI Spike Sample Images — Attribution

All images are real photographs obtained from Wikimedia Commons under clearly
reusable licenses (CC BY-SA). Files are committed test fixtures — do **not**
add to `.gitignore`.

---

- **Description:** Real photograph of a home-style Chinese meal spread in Suzhou

  and bamboo).
- **Source page URL:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chinese_meal.jpg
- **Direct file URL:** https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/14/Chinese_meal.jpg

- **License:** CC BY-SA 2.5 (Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5)
- **License URL:** https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/
- **Type:** Real photograph (Nikon Coolpix E950, 2005)
- **Original dimensions / size:** 1600 × 1200 px, 599,067 bytes
- **isChineseLabel:** n/a (meal photo)

## 2. `nutrition_label.jpg`

- **Description:** Real photograph of a Chinese nutrition-facts label
  (营养成分表) compliant with **GB 28050** (2025 version). Fields visible:
  能量 / 蛋白质 / 脂肪 (including 饱和脂肪) / 碳水化合物 (including 糖) / 钠,
  with per-100g values and NRV% column. This image is a crop extracted by the
  author from their own photograph of a congee-can packaging.
- **Source page URL:** https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chinese_nutrition_facts_label_2025_version_(sample)-20260221.jpg
- **Direct file URL:** https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/31/Chinese_nutrition_facts_label_2025_version_%28sample%29-20260221.jpg
- **Author:** Shwangtianyuan
- **License:** CC BY-SA 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0)
- **License URL:** https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
- **Type:** Real photograph (HONOR ALT-AN00 phone camera, 2026-02-21; EXIF intact)
- **Original dimensions / size:** 1124 × 845 px, 375,244 bytes
- **isChineseLabel:** true
